meta.name: fluidsim
meta.description: Plan, configure, inspect, restart, and analyze bounded FluidSim computational-fluid-dynamics simulations with explicit numerical-validity and HPC safety checks. Use for FluidSim solver selection, parameter review, FFT/MPI setup, output diagnostics, or restart compatibility.

copy.tagline: 规划和配置流体动力学模拟，确保数值有效性。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理、分析或重启流体模拟。
copy.tagline_en: Plan and configure fluid dynamics simulations with numerical validity checks.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage, analyze, or restart fluid simulations.

howto.what: Claude 将协助用户规划、配置、检查、重启和分析基于 FluidSim 的 CFD 模拟，包括选择求解器、调整参数、设置 FFT/MPI、诊断输出文件以及检查模拟重启的兼容性。
howto.when: 当用户请求帮助进行 FluidSim 模拟，例如询问安装、运行示例、选择求解器或分析结果时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 FluidSim 创建一个 2D 湍流模拟，分辨率设为 256x256。
say.note: Claude 会提供参数配置和运行步骤。

say.text: 如何将我的模拟用 MPI 在 8 个进程上运行？
say.note: Claude 会指导编写脚本和 mpirun 命令。

howto.what_en: Claude will help plan, configure, inspect, restart, and analyze bounded FluidSim CFD simulations, including solver selection, parameter tuning, FFT/MPI setup, output diagnostics, and restart compatibility checks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests assistance with FluidSim simulations, such as installation, running examples, solver selection, or result analysis.

say_en.text: Help me set up a 2D turbulence simulation with FluidSim at 256x256 resolution.
say_en.note: Claude provides parameter configuration and run steps.

say_en.text: How to run my simulation with MPI on 8 processes?
say_en.note: Claude guides script and mpirun command.
